name: Goodbye Time Traveler
source:
Meet the weirdly nameless main character. A 21 years old cynical college student living a boring pathetic life except for the fact that he is cursed with a strange phenomena. A phenomena that causes him to ''Time skip'' with no memories to what happened...

Discover the horrible truth of the universe , fight for what you believe is right...
Whether you guide the world to salvation or destruction is all up to ''YOU"...
Only ''YOU'' can decide the fate of the world and every world and timeline out there...

[From [url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/goodbye-time-traveler]itch.io[/url]]
